errors.evidence: The list of countries on the x-axis is incomplete. It omits 'Словения' (Slovenia) which is between Slovakia and Czechia, and 'Дания' (Denmark) which is between Finland and Poland.
The country name 'Белгия' (Belgium) is misspelled as 'Белия'.
The chart is a stacked bar chart, not a grouped bar chart. The segments for each year are stacked on top of each other within a single bar for each country.
The color-to-year mapping is incorrect. According to the legend, 2018 is orange/brown, 2019 is grey, and 2020 is yellow. The description has incorrectly assigned the colors for these years.

errors.text_span: Най-ниските стълбове са за Словакия през 2016 г.
errors.evidence: This statement is ambiguous. It confuses the total bar for a country with a single year's segment. The lowest total bar corresponds to Slovakia (across all years), not just a value 'през 2016 г.' (in 2016).

errors.text_span: Най-високите стълбове са за Румъния през 2020 г.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The country with the highest total bar is clearly Bulgaria, not Romania. The phrasing is also ambiguous, conflating the total bar with a single year's value.

errors.text_span: Има видима тенденция стойностите да се увеличават с увеличаване на годините, но това не е валидно за всички страни.
errors.evidence: This statement provides an interpretation of a trend within the data (values increasing over years) rather than a direct description of the visual elements of the chart.
The description fails to mention a key organizational feature of the chart: the countries on the x-axis are sorted in ascending order based on the total height of their respective bars.
